implementation_state: All five gates now have passing fixtures, mutation-verified: the endpoint check judges the answer rather than accepting any HTTP response, actions own the processes they start, config validation parses a real file and refuses a format it cannot read, and CopyConfig reports credential-shaped keys it propagated. Status is held at PARTIAL rather than DONE for one reason that is not a gate: nothing in the application calls MigrationExecutor yet, so this is implemented and proven but not integrated. Two boundaries are deliberate rather than pending. StopExternal observes and never kills, because this migration did not start that process. Core cannot route a copied secret to a credential store -- that is the desktop layer's job, where ccswitch::credential_fingerprint already sets the convention -- so CopyConfig warns instead of pretending to protect the secret.
unblock_condition: Implement the typed runner and pass local child-process, config, auth, and endpoint fixtures.
notes: Migration is a parallel sidecar, not a completed product lifecycle.
